artifact.library.title: Artifacts
artifact.chat.handoffPrompt: Use the attached artifact as the visual target and implement it in this project’s real code. Read the artifact first. This is an explicit code handoff, not another artifact edit. Preserve the artifact and adapt the implementation to this project’s existing components and conventions.
artifact.library.empty: No artifacts. Draw one on the canvas or ask in chat.
artifact.library.projectsIntro: Sketches and mockups you made with the agent. They stay here even after a project is deleted. To use one on a canvas, open a project and choose Artifacts in the left rail.
artifact.rename.label: Rename artifact
artifact.text.label: Edit text
artifact.text.hint: Enter to save · Shift+Enter for a new line
artifact.text.unsupported: This text can’t be edited directly. Use Project Chat.
artifact.text.unsupportedSave: Text not saved. Edit it or use Project Chat.
artifact.text.stale: This artifact changed. Copy your text, then reopen the editor.
artifact.text.unavailable: Couldn’t edit this text. Try again.
artifact.delete.failed: Artifact not deleted. Reopen it and try again.
artifact.library.legacy: Legacy artifact: this document is preserved read-only with its original references.
artifact.library.legacyExtra: {count} extra HTML documents are preserved but not authorized by the manifest. Changes and export are unavailable.
artifact.library.unavailable: The artifact library could not be read. Try again.
artifact.library.readOnly: Made in a newer Onlook version
artifact.export.panel.title: Export
artifact.export.panel.emptyBody: To export, select an Artifact or browser frame on the canvas.
artifact.export.panel.unexportable.mixed: This selection can’t be exported yet
artifact.export.panel.unexportable.body: To export, select an Artifact or browser frame.
artifact.export.unavailable: This export is unavailable. Reopen the artifact and try again.
artifact.export.missing: This artifact is no longer available.
artifact.export.newerReader: Open this artifact in a newer version of Onlook before exporting.
artifact.export.files: The artifact has missing, linked or unsupported files.
artifact.export.privacy: Remove machine paths, local URLs, project names and credentials before exporting.
artifact.export.references: Use only bundled local pages, scripts, styles, PNG/JPEG images and WOFF fonts. Remove remote, encoded, missing or cyclic references.
artifact.export.tooLarge: The exported HTML exceeds 20 MB. Remove large assets or split the idea before exporting.
artifact.export.changed: The artifact changed while exporting. Try again to export its current document.
artifact.export.writeFailed: The file could not be saved. Choose another location and try again.
artifact.export.cancelled: Export cancelled. The artifact is unchanged.
